p1: I build educational web platforms and microservices, and develop ML and IoT solutions. After many years in education, I now focus on software development and help emerging engineers grow. I lead projects from architecture and APIs through interfaces and databases to deployment.

web.title: Web platforms
web.text: I build with Django, FastAPI and Vue.js, from monoliths to microservices. I design databases and message queues, and set up DevOps, Docker and CI/CD.

machineLearning.title: Machine learning & robotics
machineLearning.text: I develop neural network and computer vision solutions, and build and program robots.

iot.title: Programmable electronics & IoT
iot.text: I design electronic devices, write firmware and integrate them into IoT systems with Arduino, ESP32 and Raspberry Pi.

mentoring.title: Mentoring
mentoring.text: I mentor school and university students, helping them take projects from an idea and prototype to competition entry. I also mentor at a career center.
